name: Profile Views for Ultimate Member
author: Simple Plugins

sections.description:
Profile Views for Ultimate Member allows users to see who has viewed their profiles, receive profile-view notifications, and track visitor history directly within Ultimate Member.

The plugin integrates with Ultimate Member and provides profile owners with information about their visitors, including names, visit times, and available location details.

Key Features

  • Profile View Notifications – Notify users when their profiles receive visits.
  • Visitor History – Display information about profile visitors, including available names, locations, and visit times.
  • Anonymous Visitor Tracking – Support tracking visitors who are not logged in.
  • Role-Based Controls – Enable or disable profile-view functionality for specific Ultimate Member user roles.
  • Enabled by Default – Automatically enable profile views on new installations.
  • Preserve Existing Settings – Keep previously configured role settings when updating.
  • View History Management – Allow users to clear their profile-view history.
  • Developer Filters – Customize anonymous tracking and view-count refresh intervals.

Third-Party Service: ip-api.com

Earlier versions of Profile Views for Ultimate Member used ip-api.com to determine visitors’ approximate geographical locations based on their IP addresses.

In version 1.3.3, automatic requests to ip-api.com are disabled by default. Previously recorded visitor locations may still be displayed. The plugin’s core profile-view tracking functionality does not require this service.

If an administrator or developer enables an integration with ip-api.com, visitor IP addresses are transmitted to the service for geolocation processing. The service may receive the visitor’s IP address and associated request information.

Service provider: ip-api.com
Service website: https://ip-api.com/
Terms and policies: https://ip-api.com/docs/legal
Privacy policy: https://ip-api.com/docs/legal

Website administrators should review the service’s terms and privacy practices before enabling geolocation and ensure that their website’s privacy policy appropriately discloses this processing.

Privacy and Data Handling

The plugin records profile visits to provide view counts, notifications, and visitor history.

Depending on the type of visitor, stored information may include the visitor’s identity or an anonymous identifier, the profile visited, and the date and time of the visit.

New anonymous visitor identifiers are hashed rather than storing raw IP addresses in new tracking records.

Website administrators are responsible for ensuring that visitor tracking complies with applicable privacy and data protection requirements.

Requirements

This plugin requires Ultimate Member to be installed and activated.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New Plugin.
  3. Search for Profile Views for Ultimate Member.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  5. Make sure the Ultimate Member plugin is installed and activated.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the Profile Views for Ultimate Member plugin ZIP file.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin after installation.
  5. Ensure Ultimate Member is installed and activated.

Alternatively, extract the ZIP file and upload the profile-views-for-ultimate-member folder to /wp-content/plugins/ using FTP or your hosting file manager. Then activate the plugin from your WordPress dashboard.

Configuration

Profile Views is enabled by default on new installations.

To configure profile-view tracking for specific user roles:

  1. Navigate to Ultimate Member → User Roles.
  2. Edit the user role you want to configure.
  3. Locate the Profile Views settings.
  4. Enable or disable Enable profile views feature?.
  5. Save your changes.

Existing installations retain their previously configured role settings.

Verifying Installation

  1. Log in with an Ultimate Member user account.
  2. Open that user’s public profile in another browser or an incognito window.
  3. Return to the user’s profile and check for profile-view notifications or visitor history.

Anonymous visitor tracking is enabled by default unless disabled through the pvum_track_anonymous_users filter.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Ultimate Member?

Yes. Profile Views for Ultimate Member requires the Ultimate Member plugin to be installed and activated.

How can users see who viewed their profiles?

The plugin integrates with Ultimate Member’s profile system and displays profile-view notifications and visitor information, including available names, locations, and visit times.

Are profile views enabled by default?

Yes. Profile Views is enabled by default on new installations. Existing installations retain their previously configured role-based settings.

Can I enable or disable profile views for specific user roles?

Yes. Navigate to Ultimate Member → User Roles, edit the desired role, and locate the Profile Views settings. You can enable or disable the feature for that role.

Does the plugin track anonymous visitors?

Yes. The plugin supports tracking visitors who are not logged in. Anonymous tracking is enabled by default and can be disabled using the pvum_track_anonymous_users filter.

Does the plugin show visitors’ locations?

Previously recorded location information may be displayed. Earlier versions used ip-api.com to determine approximate visitor locations. Automatic geolocation lookups are disabled by default in the updated version.

Will updating the plugin delete existing profile-view history?

The plugin is designed to preserve existing profile-view history and role settings during updates.

Can I change how frequently the profile-view count refreshes?

Yes. Developers can customize the refresh interval using the pvum_count_refresh_interval filter. The default interval is 10 seconds.

Can users clear their profile-view history?

Yes. The plugin includes functionality for clearing profile-view history.

Is the plugin compatible with the latest Ultimate Member version?

Version 1.3.3 includes compatibility improvements for recent Ultimate Member releases. Full live integration testing is still recommended before production deployment.
sections.changelog:
1.3.3

  • ### Version 1.3.3
  • Improved compatibility with recent versions of Ultimate Member.
  • Improved profile-view tracking and notification reliability.
  • Enhanced AJAX security with nonce verification and authorization checks.
  • Improved anonymous visitor tracking and data handling.
  • Enabled profile views by default for new installations.
  • Preserved existing role-based settings and profile-view history during updates.
  • Improved integration with Ultimate Member’s profile system.
  • Updated plugin dependency declaration to require Ultimate Member.
  • Disabled automatic external IP geolocation requests by default.
  • Updated plugin metadata, author information, and compatibility documentation.
  • ### Version 1.2.1
  • Previous stable release featuring profile-view notifications, visitor history, anonymous visitor tracking, and role-based controls.

1.3.1

  • Fix profile view count and viewer list AJAX responses.
  • Restrict viewer data and counts to the profile owner and verify AJAX nonces.
  • Store hashed identifiers for new anonymous visitors instead of raw IP addresses.
  • Preserve existing viewer history and support legacy records.
  • Harden malformed history handling and viewer rendering.
  • Target Ultimate Member 2.14.2; runtime verification still required.
